briefed_task: Give the conformant receipt emitter a caller: make `apr test llm bench --band` emit a receipt scripts/perf_gate.sh accepts.
headline: The briefed code change was ALREADY IMPLEMENTED on an unmerged branch. What was genuinely missing was the PROOF, and producing it surfaced a new defect in the schema authority on main.

finding_1_the_bridge_already_exists.evidence: crates/apr-cli/src/commands/test_llm_band.rs on feat/r1-2719 (PR #2742, OPEN, head a184073ef) calls ReceiptInput::render_string() and writes receipt.rN.json. Its own module docs state the defect and close it: 'Both halves close here.'
finding_1_the_bridge_already_exists.feat/v7-receipt: 3bb5eb4f6, unmerged, is a superset lineage (NOT a descendant of feat/r1-2719 -- git merge-base --is-ancestor says NO). It adds the PERF-048 provenance fixes for #2754/#2755/#2756.
finding_1_the_bridge_already_exists.consequence: Re-implementing the bridge on main would have duplicated ~7,200 lines across 46 files and conflicted with both branches. Not done. PERF-055 should be closed as a duplicate of PERF-025, or re-scoped to 'land r1/v7'.

finding_2_the_proof_never_existed.before: `git grep 'VERDICT PASS'` over the whole repo, all branches checked, matched only perf_gate.sh's own source. The gate's real mode (--host/--phase/--workload/--receipt) had never been shown accepting a receipt produced by an actual run, on main or on either feature branch.

run.binary: apr 0.64.0 built from feat/r1-2719 a184073ef, sha256 70e62d71a39e418ed1deb377c5056e48d77463c768be1a510d107b068cda8d81
run.provenance_proved_by_content: strings -a $BIN | grep -cF "exceeds the receipt's u32 concurrency field" -> 1 (string exists only on r1/v7, not on main)

finding_3_new_defect_the_join_key_is_unv.severity: the field exists solely to make cross-model comparison inexpressible, and it did not
finding_3_new_defect_the_join_key_is_unv.what_happened: The first real receipt read "model": "default" and scripts/perf_gate.sh returned VERDICT PASS on it.
finding_3_new_defect_the_join_key_is_unv.producer_side: test_llm_band.rs does `model: args.model.to_string()` -- provenance.model is the operator's --model flag, whose clap default is the literal string `default`. Present on feat/r1-2719 AND on feat/v7-receipt (line 223); NOT among the three defects v7 fixes.
finding_3_new_defect_the_join_key_is_unv.server_side: apr serve echoes any model string it is handed. Measured: a request for `llama3-70b-there-is-no-such-model` was answered by the loaded 0.5B Qwen with "model":"llama3-70b-there-is-no-such-model". The CLI help's claim that `apr serve` does not ignore the request model name is therefore false for this path.
finding_3_new_defect_the_join_key_is_unv.validator_side_before: bench_receipt.py::_check_join_key checked only ABSENCE, and recorded it by mutating the receipt dict with `_join_key_incomplete` -- a marker that `git grep` shows is written at bench_receipt.py:56 and read by ZERO other lines in the repo. A placeholder value produced no marker at all.
finding_3_new_defect_the_join_key_is_unv.fix: A join-key value that is present and meaningless is now an error. Absence is deliberately left as-is: that is the documented #2696 deferral, scoped 'until every producer emits it', and 00_pristine.json depends on it. A producer emitting `default` HAS emitted it -- it asserted a fact it does not have, which the deferral does not cover.
finding_3_new_defect_the_join_key_is_unv.follow_up_for_whoever_lands_r1_or_v7: provenance.model should be read from the server, not copied from the request flag. GET /api/tags on apr serve already returns the loaded model (`qwen2.5-coder-0.5b-instruct-q4_k_m:latest`); GET /v1/models returns only the echoed placeholder `default`.

three_states_measured.1-placeholder-receipt-UNFIXED-gate.txt: VERDICT PASS  <- the defect: a meaningless join key sails through
three_states_measured.2-placeholder-receipt-FIXED-gate.txt: VERDICT FAIL  <- the fix bites on a REAL artifact, not a fixture

not_fixed_here_reported_instead.arm_A_is_silent_on_a_single_band_receipt: arm_a_scaling loops `for c in sorted(bands): if c==1: continue`. A receipt carrying only c=1 therefore produces ZERO Arm A output and exits 0. The c=1 acceptance run above passed Arm A without Arm A evaluating anything. Defensible (scaling_efficiency needs c>1) but it means a single-band receipt is gated by Arm C alone.
not_fixed_here_reported_instead.arm_C_swallows_the_schema_reason: main's perf_gate.sh:30 runs bench_receipt.py with >/dev/null 2>&1 and prints only 'bench_receipt.py rejected the receipt' -- visible in 2-placeholder-receipt-FIXED-gate.txt, where the actual reason is lost. Already fixed on feat/r1-2719 (it captures and prints schema_out); not duplicated here.
not_fixed_here_reported_instead.workload_label_is_decoupled_from_the_pro: #2756, open on r1, fixed on v7. Reproduced live: the run declared `--workload W1` while sending `--profile micro` prompts (10 in / 1 out) and the receipt records "workload": "W1" regardless. §4.3.1 W1 is 512+-8 in / 128 out.
not_fixed_here_reported_instead.api_tags_quantization_is_wrong: GET /api/tags reports quantization_level "Q5_0" for qwen2.5-coder-0.5b-instruct-q4_k_m.gguf. Not chased; noted for the GGUF file_type advisory class.
